Package com.bilt.pos.session

Class PaymentFlow

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.PaymentFlow
public final class PaymentFlow extends Object
The payment orchestration chain returned by CheckoutSession.pay().

Registering handlers sends nothing; the sequence — rebate redemption, point redemption, stored value, card payment, award — runs when execute() (asynchronously, on the session's operation thread), executeSync() (blocking), get(), or getOrNull() is invoked. Each step handler receives that step's result and returns the updated total for the next step (letting the register recompute tax on discounted amounts).


 session.pay()
     .onRebatesRedeemed(rebates -> rebates.getSuggestedTotal())
     .onPointsRedeemed(points -> points.getSuggestedTotal())
     .onSuccess(result -> register.printReceipt(result.getMerchantReceipt()))
     .onError(error -> PaymentOptions.voidAndAbort())
     .execute();

With execute(), every handler — the step handlers, onSuccess, onError, and onComplete — is delivered through the callback executor (the session builder's callbackExecutor, or the per-flow callbackOn(Executor) override), and the payment thread waits for each answer: the handlers are part of the payment negotiation, so their return values steer the sequence exactly as if they ran inline — they just physically run on the integrator's thread. Keep them quick (the payment is paused while they run), and never block a callback thread on this flow's get() — the flow would be waiting on that thread's handler while it waits on the flow. Without a callback executor, handlers run directly on the thread executing the sequence.

If a step fails, the onError handler decides how to recover via the PaymentOptions it returns; committed steps are reversed before a retry or failure. The default (no handler) is PaymentOptions.voidAndAbort().

  • Method Details

    • callbackOn

      public PaymentFlow callbackOn(Executor executor)
      Delivers this flow's handlers through executor instead of the session's default callback executor. Affects execute() only — the synchronous paths always dispatch on the calling thread.

    • beforeStep

      public PaymentFlow beforeStep(Function<TransactionContext,String> handler)
      Called before each step; returns the SaleTransactionID to use. Default: a fresh UUID per step.

    • onRebatesRedeemed

      public PaymentFlow onRebatesRedeemed(Function<RebateRedemptionResult,BigDecimal> handler)
      Called when rebates/coupons are committed. Returns the updated total for the next step. Default: accept, previousTotal − rebates.

    • onPointsRedeemed

      public PaymentFlow onPointsRedeemed(Function<PointRedemptionResult,BigDecimal> handler)
      Called when points/rewards are redeemed for monetary value. Returns the updated total. Default: accept, subtract the monetary value.

    • onGiftCardPayment

      public PaymentFlow onGiftCardPayment(Function<GiftCardPaymentResult,BigDecimal> handler)
      Called when the stored value card is charged. Returns the updated total. Default: accept, subtract the charged amount.

    • onSuccess

      public PaymentFlow onSuccess(Consumer<CheckoutResult> handler)
      Called after the full sequence completes successfully.

    • onError

      public PaymentFlow onError(Function<SessionError,PaymentOptions> handler)
      Called when a step fails; the returned PaymentOptions controls recovery — retry (e.g. retryWithoutLoyalty()) or voidAndAbort(). Default: voidAndAbort().

    • onComplete

      public PaymentFlow onComplete(Runnable handler)
      Registers a hook that runs exactly once after the payment settles, on every path — success, failure, unexpected exception, or rejection because the session ended before the payment could run. The place for cleanup that must not leak. A throwing hook is logged, never propagated.

    • execute

      public final void execute()
      Runs the flow asynchronously on the session's operation thread — handlers included, see the class docs — and returns immediately. When the session has already ended and its executor rejects the submission, the flow fails with SessionErrorCode.INVALID_STATE through onError and onComplete.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the flow has already run

    • executeSync

      public final void executeSync()
      Runs the flow blocking — the operation takes its turn on the session's operation thread (queueing behind anything in flight, so a sync call never races an asynchronous one) while the caller waits; handlers dispatch on the calling thread.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the flow has already run

    • get

      public final CheckoutResult get()
      Runs the flow if it has not run yet and returns the result. Waits for an in-flight execute() to settle first.
      Throws:
      SessionException - if the flow failed

    • getOrNull

      public final CheckoutResult getOrNull()
      Like get() but returns null on failure.
